content.title: Activist Daniel Thomas Pleads Guilty to Criminal Damage in English Channel
content.caption: Danny Tommo, also known as Daniel Thomas, admitted to slashing a dinghy with a knife in the English Channel.

slides.heading: Danny Tommo Admits Criminal Damage
slides.text: Danny Tommo, also known as Daniel Thomas, pleaded guilty to criminal damage in the English Channel.

slides.heading: Incident in the English Channel
slides.text: A dinghy was slashed with a knife by a 37-year-old activist in the English Channel.

slides.heading: Prosecutor's Statement
slides.text: The prosecutor stated that the defendant instructed his vessel to be steered towards the empty RIB that was adrift.

slides.heading: Sentencing
slides.text: The maximum sentence for criminal damage valued at more than £5,000 is 10 years' imprisonment.
